ticket.title: Services in front container are not available once the container is cached
ticket.bug:
If you try to access one of the following service:
- `configuration`
- `context`
- `db`
- `shop`
- `employee`
from the front container when the cache is empty, the first time you try to access it, it will work, but not the second time when the cache is created.
ticket.expected: Services should be always available
ticket.steps:
1. Clear the cache `rm -rf var/cache/*`
2. Open `controllers/front/IndexController.php` and add the following lines in the `initContent()` function:
```php
$container = ContainerBuilder::getContainer('front', true);
$entityManager = $container->get('shop');
```
3. Open your browser and try to access the front office of your shop
4. No error
5. Refresh
6. See error

resolution.title: Fix compiled legacy container
resolution.description: The way the front container is build makes services unavailable once the container is cached. This PR fixes it.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: Translatations - Error in Email - Body Translations
ticket.bug:
On 1.7.8, when I modify translations of Email Body, an error is displayed. There was no error in 1.7.7.

Content of the error : "Email subject translation file not found in _[PATH]_/mails/fr/"
ticket.expected: No error :smile:
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to International > Translations
2. In "Modify Translations" select "Email translations", then "Body" and any theme or language, then click the "Modify" button

resolution.title: Avoid errors display when Emails translations lang.php does not exist
resolution.description: The lang.php is the file where mails template overrides are stored. When you go Go to Admin > International > Translations, In modify translations form, choose Emails, Emails body, choose a language, the modifications made are saved in /mails/LOCALE/lang.php. If no override have been done yet, this file doesn't exist.  The goal of this PR is to not display errors when lang.php file doesn't exist in the locale mails directory as before 1.7.8.x.
resolution.how_to_test:
Go to Admin > International > Translations, In modify translations form, choose Emails, Emails body, choose a language
  • When no lang.php exists in /mails/LOCALE/, no error has to be display
  • If you override a module mail subject and refresh the page, the updated subject have to be displayed (see https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/19288)
resolution.author: sowbiba

resolution.title: Fix no active payment module displayed in Payment Methods
resolution.description: Since #19944, `_PS_TAB_MODULE_LIST_URL_` is defined as an empty string but in `PaymentModulesPresenter::present()`, `tabModuleListProvider->getTabModules()` calls [`Tab::getTabModulesList()`](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.x/classes/Tab.php#L704) that relies on `_PS_TAB_MODULE_LIST_URL_` which leads to an empty list of modules in Payments > Payment Methods. This PR fixes it.

resolution.title: Fix order notes not being saved
resolution.description: in the object model, the field was of type string, instead of HTML, keeping notes with HTML brackets like `<mynote>` from being stored, because a strip tag was applied. We put it in HTML without any `validate`, so it does not purify it and we can treat it as a simple string. Otherwise using type `STRING` will result of an `escape` call inside the `pSQL` function.
resolution.author: matthieu-rolland

ticket.title: Cache folders are duplicated
ticket.bug: Few last versions of prestashop has been creating both `prod` and `pro_` folders in _var/cache/_. It seems also `dev` and `de_` are being created. What is that all about?

resolution.title: Let Symfony handle kernel reboot
resolution.description: Since #21429 has been merged, when the cache gets cleared, a new folder in `var/cache/` is created where the kernel warms up but is never used then. The command `cache:clear` can be used with the option `--no-optional-warmers` that will only reboot the kernel without warming optional cache as `SymfonyCacheClearer` was mean to do.
resolution.how_to_test: Try to install/uninstall `ps_facebook`, no `de_` or `pro_` folder should be present in the `/var/cache/` folder.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: Width and Height values are fixed for Header shop logo
ticket.bug: In prestashop 1.7.8 with recent changes to fix CLS, fixed values for width and heigh has been added to template. That causing problem when someone is adding images with different ratio than has been assumed.
ticket.expected:
Header template - [this lines](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0-build/themes/classic/templates/_partials/header.tpl#L65), value shouldn't be fixed.
In FrontController.php we could replace that 'logo' field in `$shop` array with new structure:
```
'logo' => [
  'src' => $logoSrc,
  'width' => $logoWidth,
  'height' => $logoWidth
]
```
Values could be fetched with getimagesize function.
Don't forget about `themes/classic/templates/checkout/_partials/header.tpl` where logo is also used.
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. In BO go to Design->Theme & Logo.
2. Replace shop logo with this [image](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c5/Prestashop.svg/1024px-Prestashop.svg.png)
3. Go to FO, and inspect shop logo in browser.
4. Images width and height values will be `width="100" height="28"` even if images ratio is different.

resolution.title: Fetch and set logo image size inside template
resolution.description: Instead of setting width and height fixed for shop logo, we are fetching it size and set proper width and height values. It required to adjust json-ld where logo was fetched from `$shop.logo`.    We are changing `$shop.logo` variable from `string` to `array` and it is breaking change. Themes and module that are using `$shop.logo` as src logo will have to change it to `$shop.logo.src`.
resolution.author: Oksydan

ticket.title: The product-list on the checkout does not work with custom themes
ticket.bug:
This fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 breaks the "Add to cart" buttons in the product-list in all custom themes.

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9


Fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 adds to core.js this code to disable the "Add to cart" button:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

The problem is that all custom themes use this code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
to add the "Add to cart" button in the product-list, which means that after an update to 1.7.8.x all shops with custom themes will have this problem and it is difficult to fix it directly in the theme.

You can go here:
https://addons.prestashop.com/en/3-templates-prestashop
open any theme and check the source code of the "Add to cart" button in the product-list to see that all themes use in the product-list that code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
ticket.expected:
The "Add to cart" button should be disabled only on the product page in the form:
form#add-to-cart-or-refresh

In means that this code in the core.js:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

should be replaced with something as this:
$('form#add-to-cart-or-refresh [data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

or this code should be removed from core.js and added to /themes/classic/assets/js/theme.js
ticket.steps:
1.Install a custom theme with the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

2.Click the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

after closing the popup, all buttons are disabled:

ticket.title: Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool
ticket.bug:
Any module or function that uses the native core PrestaShop function "isDiscounted" from the Product class will rise a Notice because an uncontrolled condition inside that function that rely that you have a cart already, but in many cases you will not.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5998908/155170380-183265df-987b-445f-843d-26a64e7aea09.png)

So, the simple thing is to make the condition with if "$ids" is not false (that is the return of evaluating the context cart id_address into the Address::getCountryAndState without really a cart)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5998908/155170816-fbddbf92-16c0-4bf0-a433-f3ec76625330.png)

Of course the "problem" appear when debug mode is on.

Anyway, this produce a lot of lines into the error_log.
ticket.expected: Not any warning.
ticket.steps:
1.- Install a module or create an script that uses the "Product::isDiscounted" function and hooked/executed on a display front hook
1a.- For example https://addons.prestashop.com/es/informes-estadisticas/18739-pixel-plus-eventos-api-de-conversiones-catalogo.html or 
[wim_test27774.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/8141510/wim_test27774.zip)

2.- Enable debug mode or tail your error_log

3.- Visit any product of your store without a cart (new visitor).

4.- Execution stopped with debug mode on or a lot of lines into the error log.

resolution.title: Avoid Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool
resolution.description: When you don't have a cart already yet, any module or script that uses this function raises a Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool, because Address::getCountryAndState could return an array with the id_country, or if the cart is false, the address also and the function return a false, that is not correct evaluated into the next line (only take account that is returning an array)

I try with not allow and allow order: **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}

  • {$flag.label}

{/block} ``` But if i add the check on allow on order (product.allow_oosp) and display message, we can see that property is not initialize with correct value on catalog part and availability message is wrong : **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}

ticket.title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
ticket.bug:
When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)
ticket.expected:
Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

resolution.title: Don't check if an invalid address exists over and over again
resolution.description: It's no use checking if an id_address <= 0 exists.
resolution.how_to_test: Enable profiling mode, look for the query described in the issue, see it's not there.
resolution.author: eternoendless

ticket.title: Problem with orders with amounts without decimals
ticket.expected: The order is marked with the correct status
ticket.steps:
1. Install clean Prestashop versión >= 1.7.8.0.
2. Create currency without decimal and set as default.
3. Install the `Payment by check` and enable it or use a payment method that set the status of payment in `payment accepted (ps_order_state id 2)` or `Processing in progress (ps_order_state id 3)`.
3. Create an publish product with price lower than $1000.
4. Create and publish product with price higher than $1000.
5. Buy a product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with a price less than $ 1000. It should work fine.
6. Purchase product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with price higher than $1000. This will fail and set order to Payment Error state.

resolution.title: Avoid using _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_
resolution.description: PaymentModule::validateOrder is using the deprecated config constant `_PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_` to generate a string representation of the total amount paid with a payment module and comparing that to the cart total string representation calculated with `Context::getContext()->getComputingPrecision()`. This check will always fail when a currency with a decimal precision is different than the present `_PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ = 2` constant, hence the order will be placed in a payment error status and no log or further details will be displayed. This happens for example while using MercadoPago payment module v4.8.0 (official partner). Apparently _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ was deprecated in 1.7.7.x but this core class still uses it. The proposed change substitutes the constant with the precision value obtained from the context, just like it is used in the rest of the source code. Also a log is added to register this error situation.
resolution.how_to_test: Create a currency with decimal values different than "2", make a purchase in the FO, order is created with status Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR') instead of a valid one. Full details in bug report.
resolution.author: mpaolino

ticket.bug:
Prestashop is repeating this query several dozens of times
```
SELECT active
FROM `ps_hook` h
WHERE (h.name = "**") LIMIT 1
```
The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page:
![2021-11-25_111717](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143424749-7ccd8bfc-e566-47f7-8e4f-b5d45f790f53.jpg)

ticket.expected:
Query once the table ps_hook. Then a simple `in_array($hook_name, $active_hooks)` will do it. This can save dozens of queries depending on the page, even more than hundred (/!\) on a category page.

Screenshot on the same product page with proposed PR:
The table ps_hook is queried 7 times instead of 74
![2021-11-25_113115](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143425335-7934ca5b-4422-4dec-80ac-7db421fa4b00.jpg)

ticket.title: Customization value lost after combination change, leading to customization mess
ticket.bug: If our store has a product with customization and combination options and a customer, in the product page, first adds a customization and then changes the combination, the ID of the combination changes to "0" ("product_customization_id" input) and some weird stuff can be done, like having in the cart a product that has a mandatory combination without it, or having a product with two customizations. In the steps to reproduce, I show some examples of this behavior and if you read that section you will understand the problem.
ticket.expected: When we add the same product twice but with two different customizations, two products should appear in the cart with one customization each, and when we delete one product, only one should remain with it's customization.
ticket.steps:
Create a customizable product and add some combinations (we used sample "Customizable mug" product, and added some size combinations). Product should look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181243297-c8a3987c-4ea8-4a39-8570-fda75bb1c74e.png)
First, add a product customization (write some text and click "save customization") and then change the combination (order is the key).
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181248736-b44e1cef-8bf0-4c13-8156-5b2b338a0aa5.png)

If you inspect the input id="product_customization_id" you will see that value after the combination change has changed to "0", but customization is still shown to the user in the form above. If you refresh the page, product_customization_id value will be back to normal. But it is not only that, we can manage to do some weird stuff:

Let's start again: Access the product page, add some customization, change the combination and add the product to cart. Everything should look fine. Then repeat the process again. Add to the cart the same product with other customization and size (remember, first we have to select the customization and then change the combination).

Now the cart looks weird. We have two mugs but with two customizations each:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181244635-2dc5f660-f27f-4fe7-abd9-c8d3b64efecb.png)

If we try to delete one mug from the cart, we see that customizations dissapear, or even we can't remove one mug (at least in the interface, if we refresh the page, the cart is empty). This way we can manage to buy a customizable mug that has a mandatory customization without it.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181246225-69fd13d9-cd45-4e35-9471-148b818a2c5b.png)

Probably, more weird things can be done this way.

resolution.title: Do not reset customization in FO when changing combination (178x)
resolution.description: Solves issue https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/29185. Altough its a quick solution, some backend validation of id_customization (when customization is required) is still missing
resolution.how_to_test: refer to #29185. :warning: Requires recompiling front core assets to take effect (`./tools/assets/build.sh front-core`)

resolution.title: Clear translations cache before translating fixtures
resolution.description: In CLI the whole installation process is performed in one call. Perform a CLI install with at least the options `--language=fr --country=fr` (`php install-dev/index_cli.php --language=fr --country=fr`) 3. Check that in the BO, the side menu is in french.

ticket.title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
ticket.bug:
When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)
ticket.expected:
Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

resolution.title: Add cache to AddressFactory::addressExists()
resolution.description: Implement cache option to avoid repeat requests
resolution.author: eternoendless

When you go Go to Admin > International > Translations, In modify translations form, choose Emails, Emails body, choose a language, the modifications made are saved in /mails/LOCALE/lang.php. If no override have been done yet, this file doesn't exist.  The goal of this PR is to not display errors when lang.php file doesn't exist in the locale mails directory as before 1.7.8.x.
resolution.how_to_test:
Go to Admin > International > Translations, In modify translations form, choose Emails, Emails body, choose a language
  • When no lang.php exists in /mails/LOCALE/, no error has to be display
  • If you override a module mail subject and refresh the page, the updated subject have to be displayed (see https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/19288)
resolution.author: sowbiba

resolution.description: Since #19944, `_PS_TAB_MODULE_LIST_URL_` is defined as an empty string but in `PaymentModulesPresenter::present()`, `tabModuleListProvider->getTabModules()` calls [`Tab::getTabModulesList()`](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.x/classes/Tab.php#L704) that relies on `_PS_TAB_MODULE_LIST_URL_` which leads to an empty list of modules in Payments > Payment Methods. resolution.title: Fix order notes not being saved
resolution.description: in the object model, the field was of type string, instead of HTML, keeping notes with HTML brackets like `<mynote>` from being stored, because a strip tag was applied. We put it in HTML without any `validate`, so it does not purify it and we can treat it as a simple string. Otherwise using type `STRING` will result of an `escape` call inside the `pSQL` function.
resolution.author: matthieu-rolland

resolution.title: Let Symfony handle kernel reboot
resolution.description: Since #21429 has been merged, when the cache gets cleared, a new folder in `var/cache/` is created where the kernel warms up but is never used then. The command `cache:clear` can be used with the option `--no-optional-warmers` that will only reboot the kernel without warming optional cache as `SymfonyCacheClearer` was mean to do.

ticket.title: Width and Height values are fixed for Header shop logo
ticket.bug: In prestashop 1.7.8 with recent changes to fix CLS, fixed values for width and heigh has been added to template. That causing problem when someone is adding images with different ratio than has been assumed.
ticket.expected:
Header template - [this lines](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0-build/themes/classic/templates/_partials/header.tpl#L65), value shouldn't be fixed.
In FrontController.php we could replace that 'logo' field in `$shop` array with new structure:
```
'logo' => [
  'src' => $logoSrc,
  'width' => $logoWidth,
  'height' => $logoWidth
]
```
Values could be fetched with getimagesize function.
Don't forget about `themes/classic/templates/checkout/_partials/header.tpl` where logo is also used.
ticket.steps:
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. In BO go to Design->Theme & Logo.
2. Replace shop logo with this [image](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c5/Prestashop.svg/1024px-Prestashop.svg.png)
3. Go to FO, and inspect shop logo in browser.
4. Images width and height values will be `width="100" height="28"` even if images ratio is different.

resolution.title: Fetch and set logo image size inside template
resolution.description: Instead of setting width and height fixed for shop logo, we are fetching it size and set proper width and height values. It required to adjust json-ld where logo was fetched from `$shop.logo`.    We are changing `$shop.logo` variable from `string` to `array` and it is breaking change. Themes and module that are using `$shop.logo` as src logo will have to change it to `$shop.logo.src`.
resolution.author: Oksydan

ticket.title: The product-list on the checkout does not work with custom themes
ticket.bug:
This fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 breaks the "Add to cart" buttons in the product-list in all custom themes.

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9


Fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 adds to core.js this code to disable the "Add to cart" button:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

The problem is that all custom themes use this code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
to add the "Add to cart" button in the product-list, which means that after an update to 1.7.8.x all shops with custom themes will have this problem and it is difficult to fix it directly in the theme.

You can go here:
https://addons.prestashop.com/en/3-templates-prestashop
open any theme and check the source code of the "Add to cart" button in the product-list to see that all themes use in the product-list that code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
ticket.expected:
The "Add to cart" button should be disabled only on the product page in the form:
form#add-to-cart-or-refresh

In means that this code in the core.js:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

should be replaced with something as this:
$('form#add-to-cart-or-refresh [data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

or this code should be removed from core.js and added to /themes/classic/assets/js/theme.js
ticket.steps:
1.Install a custom theme with the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

2.Click the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

3.After the popup is closed, all other buttons will be disabled.


**Screenshots**
Before clicking the "Add to cart" button:
https://prnt.sc/18a24cm

after closing the popup, all buttons are disabled:
https://prnt.sc/18a1zux

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9

resolution.title: Fix blocking add to cart button
resolution.description: This PR fixes a regression introduced in PR described in the related issue

ticket.title: Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool
ticket.bug:
Any module or function that uses the native core PrestaShop function "isDiscounted" from the Product class will rise a Notice because an uncontrolled condition inside that function that rely that you have a cart already, but in many cases you will not.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5998908/155170380-183265df-987b-445f-843d-26a64e7aea09.png)

So, the simple thing is to make the condition with if "$ids" is not false (that is the return of evaluating the context cart id_address into the Address::getCountryAndState without really a cart)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5998908/155170816-fbddbf92-16c0-4bf0-a433-f3ec76625330.png)

Of course the "problem" appear when debug mode is on.

Anyway, this produce a lot of lines into the error_log.
ticket.expected: Not any warning.
ticket.steps:
1.- Install a module or create an script that uses the "Product::isDiscounted" function and hooked/executed on a display front hook
1a.- For example https://addons.prestashop.com/es/informes-estadisticas/18739-pixel-plus-eventos-api-de-conversiones-catalogo.html or 
[wim_test27774.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/8141510/wim_test27774.zip)

2.- Enable debug mode or tail your error_log

3.- Visit any product of your store without a cart (new visitor).

4.- Execution stopped with debug mode on or a lot of lines into the error log.

resolution.title: Avoid Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool
resolution.description: When you don't have a cart already yet, any module or script that uses this function raises a Notice: Trying to access array offset on value of type bool, because Address::getCountryAndState could return an array with the id_country, or if the cart is false, the address also and the function return a false, that is not correct evaluated into the next line (only take account that is returning an array)
resolution.how_to_test: On the issue #27774 is explained how to test it.
resolution.author: danidomen

ticket.title: [Multistore] - Product on category page display out of stock flag instead of availlable on order
ticket.bug:
>Edited by Khouloud Steps to reproduce the issue: 1. Enable Multistore & Create new Group shop with Share quantity = enabled 2. Create a shop assiciated to this Group shop 3. Create a product with quantity = 0 & allowed for order 4. Go to FO of the shop2 > Category list 5. See error > The product is displayed with out-of-stock flag ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/153606126-320f965a-e2e0-4302-b44a-9dd91f947656.png) Hello, i'm back with my bug and i found the cause: On catagory page i have product display as out of stock even if the product is availlable for order. But if I access to the product page, status is ok and product can be added on cart. More, when I add the product to cart, the status on category page change for the good status until the product are removed from the cart. Not all product are affected. I searched in code and the problem come from the out_of_sotck parameter to define if you can order product out of stock. For some product the value of out_of_stock is empty on category page instead of 0,1 or 2. In this case it should be 1. **Product.php line 5579:** ` $row['allow_oosp'] = Product::isAvailableWhenOutOfStock($row['out_of_stock']);` Problem is only on category page. Home page, product page, search page are ok. To avoid loosing customer i disable message on category page ![123515636-7b7b8e00-d698-11eb-853f-76c3ce5b1a0c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675137-c44cd4ee-ffaf-4ccd-960f-0c635e5b574b.png) ![128632685-d1507f7f-9bf3-4c52-8459-34b62a81d6ac](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675149-ebaed18e-23ac-48ef-9cbf-82baae25733f.png) ![128632731-46a0e0c9-5313-4dec-85c8-4040db14b05a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675154-59fd6ed0-5b2b-4ae7-8363-faadd7b23f43.png) ![128632843-5d73b17b-3530-48b5-939e-0583711376be](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675158-4444a40f-40ce-4183-8e0b-edaba510dff0.png) I try to come back on the classic theme to identify if the problem occurs too. At first glance, no message is displaying and it seems to be normal. But classic theme doesn't display out of stock or allows order by default. If stock equal 0, no message is displayed. I try with not allow and allow order: **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach}
{/block} ``` But if i add the check on allow on order (product.allow_oosp) and display message, we can see that property is not initialize with correct value on catalog part and availability message is wrong : **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {if $product.quantity > 0} {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach} {else} {if !$product.allow_oosp}
  • {$product.availability_message}
    • {/if} {/if}
{/block} ``` **Root cause :** After a long investigation, i found that : On class ProductAssemblerCore (ProductAssembler.php in classes foler), there is a SQL request that seach information for product. This request seach stock information by product shop and don't take account that stock is configurated to share stock 👍 ``` LEFT JOIN {$prefix}stock_available sa ON sa.id_product = p.id_product AND sa.id_shop = $idShop ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675471-d815e5f1-9383-4833-ae81-d25d5d5c89ac.png) So on category page for shared stock management between shop, information about stock are wrong
ticket.expected: When a product is availlable for order even if its qty equal 0, display on demand on category page.

**You need to have multishop with shared product stock** 

1. Define product witch capability to be order even if stock are equal to 0
2. Define stock to 0
3. Show product on category page
4. Flag is out of stock instead of On-demand

ticket.title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
ticket.bug:
When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)
ticket.expected:
Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

resolution.title: Don't check if an invalid address exists over and over again
resolution.description: It's no use checking if an id_address <= 0 exists.
resolution.how_to_test: Enable profiling mode, look for the query described in the issue, see it's not there.
resolution.author: eternoendless

ticket.title: Problem with orders with amounts without decimals
ticket.expected: The order is marked with the correct status
ticket.steps:
1. Install clean Prestashop versión >= 1.7.8.0.
2. Create currency without decimal and set as default.
3. Install the `Payment by check` and enable it or use a payment method that set the status of payment in `payment accepted (ps_order_state id 2)` or `Processing in progress (ps_order_state id 3)`.
3. Create an publish product with price lower than $1000.
4. Create and publish product with price higher than $1000.
5. Buy a product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with a price less than $ 1000. It should work fine.
6. Purchase product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with price higher than $1000. This will fail and set order to Payment Error state.

resolution.title: Avoid using _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_
resolution.description: PaymentModule::validateOrder is using the deprecated config constant `_PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_` to generate a string representation of the total amount paid with a payment module and comparing that to the cart total string representation calculated with `Context::getContext()->getComputingPrecision()`. This check will always fail when a currency with a decimal precision is different than the present `_PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ = 2` constant, hence the order will be placed in a payment error status and no log or further details will be displayed. This happens for example while using MercadoPago payment module v4.8.0 (official partner). Apparently _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ was deprecated in 1.7.7.x but this core class still uses it. The proposed change substitutes the constant with the precision value obtained from the context, just like it is used in the rest of the source code. Also a log is added to register this error situation.
resolution.how_to_test: Create a currency with decimal values different than "2", make a purchase in the FO, order is created with status Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR') instead of a valid one. Full details in bug report.
resolution.author: mpaolino

ticket.title: Customization value lost after combination change, leading to customization mess
ticket.bug: If our store has a product with customization and combination options and a customer, in the product page, first adds a customization and then changes the combination, the ID of the combination changes to "0" ("product_customization_id" input) and some weird stuff can be done, like having in the cart a product that has a mandatory combination without it, or having a product with two customizations. In the steps to reproduce, I show some examples of this behavior and if you read that section you will understand the problem.
ticket.expected: When we add the same product twice but with two different customizations, two products should appear in the cart with one customization each, and when we delete one product, only one should remain with it's customization.
ticket.steps:
Create a customizable product and add some combinations (we used sample "Customizable mug" product, and added some size combinations). Product should look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181243297-c8a3987c-4ea8-4a39-8570-fda75bb1c74e.png)
First, add a product customization (write some text and click "save customization") and then change the combination (order is the key).
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181248736-b44e1cef-8bf0-4c13-8156-5b2b338a0aa5.png)

If you inspect the input id="product_customization_id" you will see that value after the combination change has changed to "0", but customization is still shown to the user in the form above. If you refresh the page, product_customization_id value will be back to normal. But it is not only that, we can manage to do some weird stuff:

Let's start again: Access the product page, add some customization, change the combination and add the product to cart. Everything should look fine. Then repeat the process again. Add to the cart the same product with other customization and size (remember, first we have to select the customization and then change the combination).

Now the cart looks weird. We have two mugs but with two customizations each:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181244635-2dc5f660-f27f-4fe7-abd9-c8d3b64efecb.png)

If we try to delete one mug from the cart, we see that customizations dissapear, or even we can't remove one mug (at least in the interface, if we refresh the page, the cart is empty). This way we can manage to buy a customizable mug that has a mandatory customization without it.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181246225-69fd13d9-cd45-4e35-9471-148b818a2c5b.png)

Probably, more weird things can be done this way.

resolution.title: Do not reset customization in FO when changing combination (178x)

resolution.title: Clear translations cache before translating fixtures
resolution.description: In CLI the whole installation process is performed in one call. As the download of translation files is performed after the kernel is booted and the container built, they were not took into account when translating fixtures later on. This PR fixes it by clearing the translations cache and rebooting the kernel before attempting to translate the fixtures.
resolution.how_to_test: 1. Be sure that you don't have any translations folders already downloaded in `app/Resources/translations` (except the folder `default`) 2. Perform a CLI install with at least the options `--language=fr --country=fr` (`php install-dev/index_cli.php --language=fr --country=fr`) 3. Check that in the BO, the side menu is in french.
resolution.author: atomiix

ticket.title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
ticket.bug:
When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)
ticket.expected:
Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?
ticket.steps:
1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

resolution.title: Add cache to AddressFactory::addressExists()
resolution.description: Implement cache option to avoid repeat requests
resolution.author: eternoendless
